summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repo, but did not run tests or Black, and did not commit. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and extends ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the title sequence format entry (ESC ]0; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor; it returns True after buffering a title control when is_terminal is true, otherwise False, with a Google-style docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added in the existing modules: test_console.py (forced terminal, skipped on Windows), test_control.py (segment check), and test_windows_renderer.py (mocked set_title called once with "Hello, world!"). Verification is by reading only; the tests and Black formatting remain unverified.
